scope: VCS API honesty and single-phase extensive-state regression follow-up

vcs_disposition.behavior: Explicitly raises before state mutation; no active-set result is fabricated.
vcs_disposition.single_phase_convenience: Delegates to the phase equilibrium implementation and scales phase amount to preserve the initial mass basis.
vcs_disposition.container_parity: One pinned-native two-phase state compares 54 species, 5 element totals, phase moles, composition, phase charge, and global charge.

targeted_tests.limitations: The test file exercises existing single-phase equilibrium behavior and explicit rejection of unsupported multiphase VCS; it does not validate VCS parity.

sensitivity_reference_diagnostic.finding: Centered finite difference at step 1e-3 agrees with augmented sensitivity to 1.45e-8 relative; the prior one-sided step 1e-5 differed by 4.32e-6 due to first-order truncation.

prior_wave1_to_wave4_evidence.note: Historical evidence remains scoped to the exact runtime/test hashes in that manifest; this follow-up does not rebind or expand its native parity claims.
